rules.title: Berkeley Annual General Adjustment (AGA) for 2026 – Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.requirement: Eligible landlords may raise the 2025 permanent rent ceiling by no more than 1.0% for 2026, effective no earlier than January 1, 2026. The AGA is set each year at 65% of the Bay Area CPI increase, and the landlord must meet qualifying conditions and give the tenant notice.
rules.key_value: 1.0% for 2026 (65% of Bay Area CPI-U change, July 2024–June 2025)
rules.coverage_conditions: Units subject to Berkeley permanent rent ceilings where the landlord meets the eligibility conditions in Rent Board Regulation 1148.
rules.exemptions: The 2026 AGA may not be applied to tenancies that began on or after January 1, 2025 whose rents were set under the Costa-Hawkins Rental Housing Act.

coverage.unverifiable_conditions: Landlord must satisfy the Regulation 1148 eligibility conditions and give the required notice. Tenancies that began on or after 2025-01-01 with Costa-Hawkins-set rents are excluded from the 2026 AGA. The unit must be subject to Berkeley rent ceilings, and this notice does not state those coverage criteria.

rules.citation: Berkeley Mun. Code § 13.76.110A; Berkeley Rent Board Regulation 1148
rules.quoted_span: eligible landlords to increase the 2025 permanent rent ceilings by 1.0% no earlier than
rules.conflict_note: The 1.0% figure applies to the 2026 AGA year only and is recalculated annually. The building-level coverage of the Berkeley rent ceilings is not stated in this notice.
